formulas.unit_and_context: Emissions for each source stream; ADₖ is material activity data in t and negative for outputs; f = 3,664 t CO₂/t C; CCₖ is dimensionless and positive.
Used when the fuel emission factor is expressed in t CO₂/TJ; NCVₖ is the net calorific value; f = 3,664 t CO₂/t C.
Used when the material or fuel emission factor is expressed in t CO₂/t; f = 3,664 t CO₂/t C.
For mixed fuels when the biomass-zero-rating criteria at Annex III B.3.3 are met; BFₖ is the dimensionless zero-rated biomass fraction.
